description: This Java interface defines a repository for managing UserCreatedShelf entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It provides methods for retrieving shelves by user, shelf name, and ID, as well as checking for the existence of a shelf name.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for UserCreatedShelf entities, including custom query methods for shelf retrieval and existence checks.

methods.name: findAllByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all UserCreatedShelf entities associated with the specified User, including the books in each shelf.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndUser
methods.description: Finds a UserCreatedShelf by its name and associated User, with included books.

methods.name: findByShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves all shelves matching the specified shelf name, including their books.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a UserCreatedShelf by its ID, including its books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all UserCreatedShelf entries with their books.

methods.name: shelfNameExists
methods.description: Checks whether a shelf with a given name exists (case-insensitive, trimmed).
